layers.name: Multi-source Ingest
layers.summary: Ingest OSINT public data (GDELT, ACLED public, IMF WEO, World Bank WDI, UN COMTRADE, V-Dem, WID, USGS, IEA, Natural Earth, Wikidata) into local Parquet + provenance manifest hash.

layers.name: Embedding Architecture
layers.summary: Three nested embedding architectures (Cohere Embed v3 multilingual / lens-tagged academic / agent-history); HNSW ANN retrieval. STUB: in this build we use only document-level fingerprints; full embeddings deferred.

layers.name: Lens-Tagged Document Corpus
layers.summary: Tag retrieved documents with the 20 lenses based on keyword + claim-pattern signatures; threshold τ=0.50.

layers.name: Lens Proposal Engine
layers.summary: Continuous monitoring of leading IR/PE journals; LDA + Newman modularity; admission probability ≥0.60. STUB: panel frozen at 20 for first build.

layers.name: Lens-Conditional Reasoning
layers.summary: P(θ | D, lens_i, q) = Claude(θ | framing_i, context_i(q,D), q). Each lens agent reads top-K=12 lens-relevant documents and produces structured analysis.

layers.name: Coupling Matrix (Causal Discovery)
layers.summary: Bagged-PCMCI+ over ~400 macro/political variables; 1,000 candidate DAGs; high-confidence edges at p̂≥0.80. STUB: in this build the coupling matrix is hand-curated from doc / lens-agent inputs.

layers.name: Lens-Conditional Reweighting (BMA)
layers.summary: BMA with hierarchical hyper-prior over lens weights. P(θ|D,q) = Σ_i w_i(q,D) · P(θ|D,lens_i,q).

layers.name: Foundation-Model Forecast Ensemble
layers.summary: Chronos-2 + Moirai-MoE + TimesFM-2.5 ensemble via BPS + hierarchical Platt-Beta calibration. STUB: replaced in MVP with statistical baselines (ARIMA / linear / piecewise) on OSINT indicators.

layers.name: Cross-Domain Specialists
layers.summary: Aurora (climate), AlphaFold-3 (biosec), Evo-2 (genomics), METR (AI capability), country-specific DSGE. STUB: deferred.

layers.name: Agent-Based Sub-Module
layers.summary: Top-tier strategic-deep agents (LLM-driven actor agents per Doc 6 Gap 2, replacing Cicero/DiL-piKL); mid-tier mean-field MARL cohorts (stub); bottom-tier GABM populations (stub).

layers.name: Scenario Generator
layers.summary: BPS over scenario-space; cluster scenarios from agent rollouts; outputs joint posteriors per country (P(A,B,C)).

layers.name: Uncertainty Decomposition
layers.summary: Aleatoric + epistemic + lens-revision + coupling variance via Saltelli 2008 Sobol indices. STUB: only aleatoric+epistemic in MVP.

layers.name: Causal Discovery
layers.summary: PCMCI+ / J-PCMCI+ / Bagged-PCMCI+ over indicator panels; α_PC = 0.01 with BH-FDR 5%.

layers.name: Counterfactual Simulation
layers.summary: Pearl do-calculus, twin-network (Balke-Pearl), Rosenbaum bounds + E-value sensitivity, N=10,000 MC draws.

layers.name: Strategic-Deep Agents (LLM-replaced)
layers.summary: Per Doc 6 Gap 2, REPLACED Cicero/DiL-piKL with Claude-Sonnet/Opus actor agents using Richelieu pattern. KL-regularised against best-response oracle. λ_KL=0.03.

layers.name: Mean-Field MARL Cohorts
layers.summary: Yang-Wang ICML 2018 mean-field MARL for sub-state actors. STUB: deferred to Phase 2; first build uses LLM persona-aggregation.

layers.name: Generative Agent-Based Model (GABM)
layers.summary: Park et al. 2024 architecture; 1,000-10,000 LLM agents per scenario. STUB: deferred — this build uses 50-agent slice without bottom-tier population.

layers.name: BPS Apex Aggregator
layers.summary: McAlinn-West 2019; Adrian-Giannone-Luciani-West 2024. Linear synthesis over component forecasts with discount factor δ ∈ (0.9, 0.99).

layers.name: Conformal Prediction
layers.summary: Vovk-Gammerman-Shafer 2005, Lei et al. 2018; n_cal=500. Adaptive conformal (Gibbs-Candes 2021). Mondrian variants for stratified coverage.

layers.name: Falsification & Lens Reweighting
layers.summary: Pre-registered prediction sets (≥30 events per lens per quarter). Bayes factors via bridge sampling. δ_lens=0.95 quarterly discount; ENL alarm threshold ENL<4.

layers.name: Decision Layer
layers.summary: Standard expected-loss minimisation; min-max regret (Hansen-Sargent 2008); Wasserstein-DRO (Mohajerin Esfahani-Kuhn 2018); CVaR-constrained; Pareto front for multi-objective.

layers.name: Risk Aggregation (Copulas)
layers.summary: Sklar copula; vine copulas (R/C/D) per Aas et al. 2009. Clayton for sovereign-default, Gumbel for commodity-shock. STUB: simple correlation aggregation in MVP.

layers.name: Communication / Brief Render
layers.summary: ReportLab PDF (replacing WeasyPrint due to Windows GTK), Jinja2 HTML, python-docx DOCX. Charts via matplotlib SVG. Maps via cartopy + Natural Earth GeoJSON. Hallucination control: 0.5σ numeric tolerance, up to 3 regenerations.

layers.name: Audit & Provenance
layers.summary: Manifest hash H_manifest = SHA256(data || code || params || env || output). Reproducibility ε=1e-6. Sigstore signing deferred; SHA256 ledger only in MVP.

layers.name: Master Scenario Library
layers.summary: K≈80-120 scenarios partitioning Ω. Three axes: stress (5 levels), GP-config (8 archetypes), regional flashpoint set (2-4 of 12). Pruning Pr<0.005 via Wasserstein.

layers.name: Game-Theoretic Equilibrium Solver (rQRE)
layers.summary: Regularised QRE: Pr_QRE(S_i) ∝ exp{β · Σ_k w_k · U_k(S_i) - λ · KL(σ_i || π_BC)}. β default 1.0 (high-stakes 2.0); λ=0.1. Max-entropy equilibrium selection.

layers.name: Scenario Probability Estimation
layers.summary: Bayesian hierarchical Dirichlet posterior over scenarios. α_i = 0.5·Pr_QRE + 0.3·Pr_triggers + 0.2·π_analogue. CRPS alarm threshold 0.10.

layers.name: Trigger Tracking
layers.summary: Real-time Bayesian update Pr(S_i|τ,H) = Pr(τ|S_i)·Pr(S_i|H) / Σ. Drift alert thresholds 0.02 active / 0.005 baseline.

layers.name: Scenario Narrative Synthesis
layers.summary: Short 200w / Medium 400w / Long 800-1200w narratives. Numeric consistency C_1: |n-d| < 0.5·σ(d). Translation deferred to Phase 2.

layers.name: Country Cascade
layers.summary: p(y_C|data) = Σ_i Pr(S_i)·p(y_C|S_i,data) per country.

layers.name: Theme Cascade
layers.summary: p(y_T|S_i) = ∫ a(y) · Π_C∈T p(y_C|S_i) · c_copula dy over themes.

layers.name: Consistency Enforcement
layers.summary: Macro-baseline ε_macro=1e-6, NLI contradiction block threshold 0.85. Audit on cross-brief sample.

layers.name: User Profile (200-field JSON)
layers.summary: User profile with lens weights, exposures, decision spec, brief preferences. STUB: deferred — first build serves Future Innovation AI Group founder profile only.

layers.name: Personalised L21/L22 Re-run
layers.summary: Per-user decision and risk recomputation. STUB: deferred.

layers.name: Persona-Conditioned LLM Brief Render
layers.summary: Per-user LLM persona for brief tone / detail. STUB: deferred.

layers.name: Per-Tenant Isolation + DP Noise
layers.summary: Multi-tenant isolation with DP noise (ε=1.0, δ=1e-5). STUB: deferred — single-tenant MVP.

layers.name: Type-1 Profile Customisation
layers.summary: 100-question LLM intake (90-120 min, 9 domains). STUB: deferred — first build assumes single founder profile.

layers.name: Type-2 Scenario-Set Customisation
layers.summary: Customer Bayesian-net overlay; add/remove/expand/condition scenarios. STUB: deferred.

layers.name: Type-3 Interrogative Q&A
layers.summary: Cross-cutting NL gateway routing to L13/L14/L18/L20/L22/L29. STUB: deferred.

layers.name: Live Workspace
layers.summary: Stateful Redis+Postgres; WebSocket subscriptions; multi-user collab. STUB: deferred.

layers.name: Polycrisis Cascade Engine
layers.summary: Cascade Institute Polycrisis Core Model v2.5 + Weimer-Jehle CIB. 11 subsystems, 500 expert judgements, 10^4-10^6 configurations. STUB: hand-curated cross-impact matrix in MVP.

layers.name: Adversarial-Reflexivity Auditor
layers.summary: Hansen-Sargent ambiguity, bounded-depth 2-3 reflexivity, Aghassi-Bertsimas robust game theory. STUB.

layers.name: EGTA + PSRO
layers.summary: Wellman-Tuyls-Greenwald JAIR 2025 + PSRO (Lanctot 2017). Best-response oracle via PPO/SAC. STUB.

layers.name: Horizon Scanner
layers.summary: BERTopic streaming + LDA fallback + IsolationForest novelty + BERTrend. Hiltunen Future Sign 3D. STUB.

layers.name: Causal Sensitivity
layers.summary: E-values + Rosenbaum Γ + Cinelli-Hazlett OVB. STUB.

layers.name: AI Capability Forecaster
layers.summary: METR Time Horizon (~7-month doubling) + Epoch AI compute (5×/yr frontier, 3×/yr efficiency) + FRI elicitation. STUB.

layers.name: Distributional Macro
layers.summary: WID DINA Guidelines 2025; Bilbiie-Monacelli-Perotti JME 2024 inequality-aware HANK. STUB.

layers.name: Network Resilience (legacy)
layers.summary: Sillmann Nat Comms 2025, ESRank, percolation. SUPERSEDED by L56 in v9.0. Transition layer.

layers.name: Behavioural / Cognitive Hierarchy
layers.summary: Camerer-Ho-Chong QJE 2004; Lin-Palfrey JET 2024. Prospect theory α≈0.88, λ≈2.25, γ≈0.61. STUB.

layers.name: Critical Bias Auditor
layers.summary: Acharya 2014 multiplex; region-anchored sources (Carnegie ME, Brookings Africa, ISEAS, El Colegio de México, ORF, RIAC). One Bias Auditor agent in our 50-agent slice.

layers.name: Reasoning-LLM Orchestrator
layers.summary: Routing across reasoning models. In our Claude Code build: Haiku 4.5 routine / Sonnet 4.6 default / Opus 4.7 critical.

layers.name: GraphRAG + Agentic RAG
layers.summary: Microsoft GraphRAG, LightRAG (Oct 2024, ~10× cheaper), HyDE, agentic RAG. STUB: simple keyword retrieval over OSINT cache in MVP.

layers.name: LLM Safety / Adversarial Defense
layers.summary: OWASP LLM Top 10 v2025 (LLM01:2025), Anthropic spotlighting, honeypot canaries. Detection thresholds τ=0.7 review / 0.9 block.

layers.name: LLM-as-Judge / Multi-Model Jury
layers.summary: CALM framework (Ye et al. ICLR 2025), 12-bias quantification. In our build, the Critic agent serves the jury role.

layers.name: Domain Fine-Tuning + Multimodal
layers.summary: LoRA/QLoRA/DoRA on Llama-3.1-70B / Qwen2.5-72B; FINMME benchmark. STUB.

layers.name: Network/Graph Analytics
layers.summary: DomiRank (Nature Sci Rep 2025), ESRank, ChronoWave-GNN, EG-SAN, FiGraph (WWW 2025, 730K nodes/1M edges). TGNN with continual graph learning. STUB.

layers.name: Multi-Modal GEOINT/OSINT
layers.summary: Prithvi-EO-2.0 (NASA-IBM, 1.3B), Clay (26M), SARATR-X, Aurora, GeoChat (CVPR 2024), Earth AI. AIS via Spire/Kpler/MarineTraffic. STUB.

layers.name: Cyber Threat Intel
layers.summary: MITRE ATT&CK v18-v19, STIX 2.1/TAXII 2.1, Diamond Model, Lockheed Cyber Kill Chain, Microsoft Project Ire (0.98 precision Windows drivers, 26% recall). Tallinn Manual 3.0. STUB.

layers.name: Provenance & Deception Defense
layers.summary: C2PA 2.1 (ISO/IEC 22144 2025), SynthID, Pangram (BFI 2025-116), DISARM Red+Blue, DECODE GNN (~12% accuracy improvement). STUB.

layers.name: Sanctions & Weaponized Interdependence
layers.summary: Farrell-Newman chokepoint ledger (USD-clearing, SWIFT, ASML EUV/DUV, Cadence/Synopsys/Mentor EDA, advanced packaging, REE refining, undersea cables, AWS/Azure/GCP regions). LLM-driven SDN parsing per Federal Reserve FEDS 2025-092.

layers.name: Energy / Critical Minerals / Trade
layers.summary: PyPSA-Earth/USA/DE; IEA WEO 2025 (AI data centre 485→950 TWh by 2030); USGS OFR 2025-1047 (samarium ~$4.5B); IMF Geoeconomic Fragmentation programme; Tinbergen + Anderson-van Wincoop PPML gravity. STUB.

layers.name: Treaty / Legal
layers.summary: SaulLM-141B (Equall 2024), MultiLegalPile 689GB, LegalBench, LEXam 2025, VCLT Articles 31-32. STUB.

layers.name: AI Capability/Safety Tracker
layers.summary: Anthropic RSP v3.0 (ASL-3 May 2025 activated for Claude Opus 4 — 2.53× bioweapon uplift), OpenAI Preparedness Framework, DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework, RAND RRA3797-1, FLI 2025 AI Safety Index. STUB.

layers.name: Quantum / Biosec / Climate-Eng Tail Risk
layers.summary: Quantum (NIST PQC FIPS 203/204/205, Federal Reserve FEDS 2025-093 HNDL, Willow late 2024, Quantum Echoes Oct 2025, IBM Loon Nov 2025, Hanyuan-1 Oct 2025); Biosec (AlphaFold-3, ESM-3, Evo-2 40B Feb 2025, EO 14292 May 2025); Climate-Eng (Make Sunsets, NSF NCAR, UKRI £10.5M, Simons $50M); Pandemic (PandemicLLM Nature CompSci 2025, EpiLLM, BEACON). STUB.
